title: audit.recorded (v1)
description: timetable -> school, topic audit.recorded, key school_id. The school's action journal lives in school-service; timetable records its actions there through its outbox, in the same transaction as the action, so no entry is lost (spec §07 «Журнал», §12). school-service writes its own entries directly, without this event. No surnames: actor is a login, target and details carry identifiers (spec §04; the journal shows a teacher as «Вчитель #N»).

at.description: When the action happened; the journal entry gets this time.

actor.description: Login of the scheduler (or a service name) who acted; never a teacher signature.

action.description: What was done. timetable sends: timetable_published, alert_plan_approved, alert_plan_activated, alert_plan_ended, absence_recorded, absence_cancelled, substitution_approved, substitution_rejected, qr_rotated, holidays_set, holidays_cleared, teacher_exported. A new action is a MINOR change; school-service stores any value.

target.description: Identifier the action was done on (timetable_id, activation id, teacher_id, school_id, …), or null.

details.description: Action-specific facts: identifiers, dates, counts, and order_no and order_date of a publication or approval. Never a person's name (approved_by stays in timetable), a teacher signature or a reason of absence — the journal is without surnames (spec §07 «Журнал»).
